about: Every producer the weekly Review pool reads. `reader` is the PoolSources key in Weekly.ts, wired live in Review.ts liveDeps(); `prefix` is the first segment of each pool id it makes. Paths are relative to ~/.claude unless they start with ~/. `bun LIFEOS/REVIEW/Review.ts sources` exits 1 when this list and the code disagree.

producers.what: Upgrades records recommended in the last 7 days, except source directive (standing orders are not questions)
Open ideal-state loop recommendations, plus needs-input rows from reconcile.json beside it (decisions only he can make)
Errata weekly audit proposals from the newest taxonomy, failed rows excluded
Clusters in the latest Errata triage report
Pending LearningPatternSynthesis hypotheses (status hypothesis, not expired)
The week's model advisor recommendations (its medium Vigil events)
The week's ShadowExpiry recommendations (its Vigil events)
The continuous advocate's recommendations: changes its research, prepare and background runs proposed and did not make (STATVS stream vigil-log, kind recommendation)
